title: Affine Pricing Models from Group Quantization and Holonomy
abstract: arXiv:2609.28863v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The analytic tractability of affine pricing models is usually expressed through two complementary formulations: a coordinate-space pricing operator and an exponential-affine transform representation governed by generalized Riccati equations. We develop \emph{Affine Holonomy Group Quantization} (AHGQ) as a geometric framework in which these two formulations arise from the same underlying structure. The construction separates the affine pricing symbol into a homogeneous quadratic sector and a complementary affine sector. The first generates a finite-dimensional symplectic transport and a centrally extended Lie group, while the second is represented by a multiplicative holonomy carried by a thin-path groupoid. Their combination determines an affine Poincar\'e--Cartan form. translated_title: 基于群量子化与和乐的仿射定价模型
translated_abstract: 仿射定价模型的解析可处理性通常通过两种互补的表述来体现：坐标空间定价算子，以及由广义Riccati方程支配的指数仿射变换表示。我们发展了“仿射和乐群量子化”（AHGQ）这一几何框架，使这两种表述源自同一个底层结构。该构造将仿射定价符号分解为齐次二次部分和互补的仿射部分：前者生成有限维辛输运和一个中心扩张李群，后者则由薄路径群胚承载的乘性和乐来表示。两者的结合确定了一个仿射Poincaré–Cartan形式，其特征动力学在动量变量下可简化为广义Riccati系统及其标量幅值，而坐标表示则恢复了标准的定价算子结构。
tldr: 该论文提出仿射和乐群量子化（AHGQ）几何框架，通过将仿射定价符号分解为齐次二次部分与仿射部分，将坐标空间定价算子和基于广义Riccati方程的指数仿射变换表示统一到同一底层几何结构之中。
en_tdlr: This paper develops Affine Holonomy Group Quantization (AHGQ), a geometric framework that decomposes the affine pricing symbol into a homogeneous quadratic sector and an affine sector, thereby unifying the coordinate-space pricing operator and the exponential-affine generalized Riccati representation within a single underlying structure.
